scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/ambiente.js dev prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: node scripts/ambiente.js dev prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/ambiente.js dev prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:deploy:prod: node scripts/ambiente.js prod prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:status:prod: node scripts/ambiente.js prod prisma migrate status
scripts.test:db:preparar: node scripts/ambiente.js test prisma migrate deploy
scripts.test:db: npm run test:db:preparar && node scripts/ambiente.js test vitest run --config vitest.db.config.js
